Frontend.reason: Tracker Dashboard now consumes the V1 Words cloud-only daily summary through a strictly validated, non-blocking card with the established Words product mark and a vetted product-root link. It reads once per mount and only refreshes on explicit user action; it does not persist, sync, merge or mutate any Tracker or Words record.

Backend.reason: This UI is coordinated with the formal Lexi repository's backward-compatible lexi_get_words_daily_summary RPC from step 1. The RPC derives the response from existing Words cloud rows with no summary table or cache row, rechecks auth.uid against the captured account, and must be applied and remotely verified before this Tracker commit can be deployed.

Admin.reason: The new card exposes only a transient own-account read of existing Words aggregates and creates no administrator-manageable state, policy, queue or learner-content copy. Lexi Control already reports the source Words records where relevant; no new admin search field, action or metric is required for this read-only presentation step.

Deployment.reason: Neither the Supabase migration nor this Tracker UI has been deployed in this step. Production release remains blocked until both repository gates pass, the exact migration is applied and remotely verified first, and the verified Tracker commit is then deployed and smoke-tested.

Verification.reason: The final Tracker release gate passed typecheck, oxlint, 75 test files and 469 tests, plus the pinned production build and bundle review. The formal Lexi release gate, including the zero-storage cross-product migration scenarios, also passed; local desktop and mobile browser checks verified the success, unsigned-user and manual-refresh states with no horizontal overflow or console warnings.
